name: Passive Resistor — Trimpot
description: Passive trimpot resistor cluster containing surface-mount and through-hole parts from the SparkFun KiCad library with 3386U and 3.0x3.0mm footprints.
selection_hints: Choose between through-hole (Trimpot_PTH_3386U) and surface-mount (Trimpot_SMD_3.0x3.0mm) footprints.
Verify the PCB layout matches SparkFun Trimpot package footprints.
Check nominal resistance and footprint against project requirements.
avoid_when: Fixed resistors are required rather than adjustable trimpots.
The board layout requires packages other than Trimpot_PTH_3386U or Trimpot_SMD_3.0x3.0mm.
Higher quality tiers than Tier B or components from other library sources are required.
